description:
Created to unite race speed with endurance comfort, Raso is an aero road bike built to set records and smooth the roughest roads.

When it comes to carbon bikes, fast starts from the first fibre. Designed and built in-house at our HQ in Venice, Italy, Raso benefits from decades of composites R&D and the exceptional feel and resilience of premium, locally sourced unidirectional carbon fibre.

A stylish and efficient one-piece cockpit, fluid transitions between sections and custom-formed tubes orientated to slip through the air at every angle stun well beyond the time sheets.

No Watt Left behind

Raso’s innovative frame layup demonstrates exceptional stiffness, strength, and compelling comfort, reducing vibrations and road noise without sacrificing critical watts.

A Plush Performer

With room for up to 35mm tires, Raso can float over any road for a cushioned ride that keeps you fresh for the next.

Endurance-inspired bars with 25mm / 10.75° of flare perfectly align with the flow of the shoulders and arms for a more natural connection between rider and bike.

Like every Sarto, Raso is available in custom sizing, tailored to your precise dimensions or off-the-shelf stock measurements.

And then there’s the finish.

From ombre fades to geometric patterns via standout seasonal colours, our in-house paint shop can take the personalisation of your dream ride to a whole new level.

frame.material_detail: M46J/CN80/T800 carbon, UD carbon fibre outer layer
